role: shared-identity paired reference protocol for PartNet-Mobility and PhysX-Mobility

selection.eligible_pool: dataset IDs present in the PhysX-Mobility URDF filename set and in PartNet-Mobility with an exact target-category meta.model_cat
selection.ranking_rule: within category, ascending SHA256(rank payload), then dataset_id; take first six
selection.failure_policy: retain every frozen shared ID in both requested denominators; never replace failures

claim_boundary: paired same-object representation comparison; PartNet-Mobility and PhysX-Mobility remain datasets, not generated methods
